# Alpha 45 — Folder Hub and mobile workspace polish

- Rename the mobile Files destination to Folder Hub, with a collection icon and grouped-folder Home shortcut. Select a folder for Pull/Push actions, then Browse Local, LocalCrypt or Remote to enter its file browser.
- Validate native destination labels independently from persistent routing keys. This supersedes the unpublished alpha 44 candidate.
- Align browser return links, settings and user guidance with Folder Hub naming.
- Improve mobile light/dark colours, chat presentation and streaming controls, and retain the next unsent chat draft.
- Restore workspace menu controls on first tab selection and native Back navigation; improve retained drawers and native pane verification.

Local validation passed 172 mobile UI/tooling tests and 51 mobile core tests (three native-bridge cases skipped), lint checks, a signed physical iPhone build with identity verification, and the full local iPhone native UI suite including screen review. Release publication requires the desktop platform checks and native Android/iOS build/runtime gates. TestFlight distribution uses a separately signed iOS archive; physical touch, accessibility and Duo fold gestures require device validation.
